description: A diff stage inside a suppose block lists the nodes its premise changed and leaves out a node that reads the premise but keeps its value
code:
threshold = 90
reading = 40
alarm = reading > threshold
level = reading > 10
suppose reading = 95: (model |> diff).map(step -> step.node)

description: Diff after why keeps the changed facts behind a value, and diff after affects the changed nodes that rest on an input
code:
base = 10
rate = 2
fee = 3
cost = base * rate
total = cost + fee
label = total > 40
suppose rate = 3: [(total |> why |> diff).map(step -> step.node), (base |> affects |> diff).map(step -> step.node)]

description: An instance whose property changes is not itself listed, while its changed properties and the instances a block creates are
code:
class Item
$Item.premium = $Item.price > 10
pen = Item()
pen.price = 5
suppose:
    pen.price = 20
    cup = Item()
    cup.price = 3
    (model |> diff).map(step -> step.node)

description: Values compare as writes compare them, so an equal value, a list restored by pop and a write undone by a caught failure are not differences while -0 differs from 0
code:
n = 1
z = 0
tags = ["a"]
suppose:
    n = 1
    tags.push("b")
    tags.pop()
    try:
        n = 5
        throw "UNDO"
    catch error:
        pass
    z = -0
    (model |> diff).map(step -> step.node)

description: A nested suppose block compares with its own start, and the outer block sees the inner block's value as a new node
code:
price = 10
qty = 2
total = price * qty
suppose price = 12:
    inner = suppose qty = 3: (model |> diff).map(step -> step.node)
    [inner, (model |> diff).map(step -> step.node)]

description: A function that asks for a diff compares with whichever suppose block calls it
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
subtotal = price * qty
free = subtotal > 50
def impact() => (model |> diff).map(step -> step.node)
small = suppose qty = 4: impact()
large = suppose qty = 6: impact()
[small, large]

description: Outside every suppose block the diff stage raises a TypeError
code:
a = 1
b = a + 1
try:
    b |> diff
catch error:
    out = error
out

description: A binding named diff shadows the stage, as bindings shadow the stated and derived filters
code:
a = 1
b = a + 1
diff = b - a
try:
    suppose a = 2: b |> diff
catch error:
    out = error
out
